_doc: Saving (save_game.gd, main.gd): autosave every `autosave_days` in-game days into the slots autosave1..autosave<autosave_keep> (the oldest is overwritten); `slots` numbered slots in the Save dialog; F5 saves to `quick_slot`, F9 loads it. The player can switch autosave off in the dialog (settings.cfg [save] autosave).
